article.title: Potencial de verbos ichidan
article.part: Predicación nominal y verbal — 名詞述語・動詞述語
article.chapter: Clases verbales y formas básica/cortés — 動詞グループと普通形・丁寧形

claims.summary: The Japan Foundation identifies the potential form as expressing ability and possibility and gives group 2 (ichidan) examples 見る→見られる and 食べる→食べられる; it also explicitly notes variants without ら.

locator.description: PDF, Elementary 2, Lesson 5, point 1, PDF pp. 135–136 (printed L5-21/22): potential means ability/possibility; group 2 table gives 見る→見られる and 食べる→食べられる; source separately notes variants without ら.
